newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-Riechelmann returns, Blowers in doubt.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-Riechelmann returns, Blowers in doubt.

text.p: AUCKLAND, April 30 - Talented lock Charles Riechelmann is back in the Auckland Blues team for this weekend's Super 12 rugby match against Otago three months after he broke a shoulder bone in France.

Riechelmann has had a horrible run of injuries including a damaged nerve in his shoulder which he suffered in the 1996 Super 12 last May. That kept him out of rugby and the All Blacks for the rest of the year.
When he returned to playing he injured himself in making a heavy tackle in the game against European champions Brive in France last February.
"It has been a long time for me, I only played about three games last year and half a game this year," Riechelmann told NZPA.

Tipped as a future All Black, the Aucklander was in the pre-season squad named by coach John Hart at the start of the year which prompted Blues coach Graham Henry to give him a run in the side to play Otago.
"This isn't a favour, with Jim Coe over in Australia with his company business and unavailable to us until the Wellington game we're a bit thin," Henry said.
"Richard Fromont hasn't quite recovered from his rib injury which he suffered against the Waikato Chiefs and then aggravated at training last week.
"Michael Jones is out with a tendon problem and needs to rest while we're not sure where Andrew Blowers is with his lower back problem."
Blowers will have a medical examination for a lower vertebrae problem which, if serious enough, could rule him out for the rest of the season.
Henry has put New Zealand Under 19 captain Xavier Rush, who played for the Blues in South Africa at the start of the season and has been most impressive at training, on standby.
"We don't know how bad it is (Blower's injury) but I did tell him he was starting against Otago this weekend," Henry said.
"Both Charlie and Andrew are All Blacks squad members so in fairness I have to give them a run.
"It also helps us develop a bit more depth because I feel we're still a bit thin."
Riechelmann said he was grateful for the chance to return to the side.
"It is a big call by Graham (Henry) to name me in Leo (Lafaiali'i's) place.

"Leo didn't deserve to make way and what it means is that there is a lot of responsibility to live up to what Leo's been doing over the last few weeks. Otherwise I wouldn't be doing justice to the guy."
The Blues also got some other good news with fullback Adrian Cashmore returning to the side after foot injury kept him out of the past two matches.
The news on tighthead prop Olo Brown is also promising with Henry saying the All Black cornerstone is set to return for the game against the Wellington Hurricanes.

Team: Adrian Cashmore, Joeli Vidiri, Eroni Clarke, Jeremy Stanley, Lee Stensness, Carlos Spencer, Ofisa Tonu'u, Zinzan Brooke (captain), Andrew Blowers or Mark Carter, Charles Riechelmann, Robin Brooke, Dylan Mika, Craig Dowd, Sean Fitzpatrick, Paul Thomson.
